replies.body:
good point! It's already the case, `InferenceInvocation._get_attributes` will set `GEN_AI_USAGE_REASONING_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to None if it's zero, and only non none value will be added to the attr:
https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/17ddbc6e3a9dd5b5e42ddadd4d332c95b260a8e1/util/opentelemetry-util-genai/src/opentelemetry/util/genai/_inference_invocation.py#L317-L320

https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/17ddbc6e3a9dd5b5e42ddadd4d332c95b260a8e1/util/opentelemetry-util-genai/src/opentelemetry/util/genai/_inference_invocation.py#L382

Or would you prefer handling it explicitly here as well, just to be safe?
Ah, thanks for catching that. I think it is fine as is then,
